company.name: Foxglove
company.shortDescription: Foxglove is an open-source robotics platform for visualizing, debugging, and monitoring robot systems.
company.description: Foxglove is a purpose-built platform that empowers robotics teams to visually debug robots, build reliable autonomy, and scale their development.

productsAndServices.description: A robotics observability platform for collecting, storing, analyzing, visualizing, and sharing multimodal data across robot development and operations.
productsAndServices.name: Foxglove Platform

productsAndServices.description: Interactive visualization software for exploring live and recorded robotics data, including images, video, 3D scenes, point clouds, plots, logs, and state transitions.
productsAndServices.name: Foxglove Visualization

productsAndServices.description: Cloud and self-hosted data management capabilities for ingesting, indexing, storing, searching, annotating, and retrieving robotics recordings at scale.
productsAndServices.name: Foxglove Data Management

productsAndServices.description: A Linux service that monitors robot storage, makes recordings available for import, and uploads selected data to Foxglove despite intermittent network connectivity.
productsAndServices.name: Foxglove Agent

productsAndServices.description: An open-source container file format for recording and exchanging multimodal robotics data, including messages, timestamps, schemas, and metadata.
productsAndServices.name: MCAP

productsAndServices.description: Software development kits for logging robotics messages, generating MCAP data, enabling live visualization, and connecting custom applications to Foxglove workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Foxglove SDK
